entries.title: Fragrance (Parfum)
entries.why: Umbrella term for scent mixtures. Formulas can include allergens and are often not fully disclosed as individual chemicals on the label. A common trigger for contact dermatitis in sensitive people.
sources: EU Cosmetic Regulation fragrance allergen labelling (public)
SCCS opinions on fragrance allergens (public summaries)

entries.title: Methylisothiazolinone (MIT)
entries.why: Preservative associated with a rise in contact allergy. Use in leave-on cosmetics has been restricted in the EU; still important to notice on labels of older or imported products.

entries.title: Butylparaben
entries.why: Preservative in the paraben family. Some longer-chain parabens have faced greater regulatory scrutiny regarding endocrine activity; check current regional limits and prefer products that avoid higher-concern parabens if that matters to you.
